reading.text:
Unit: Assumption23.mk, the constructor of Assumption23 (Assumption 2.3). Its type must take
exactly the clauses of Assumption 2.3 and return Assumption23 F P T L C:
  (interior) for a.e. t in [0,T], for all F_t-measurable square-integrable H-valued Theta,
   Theta' with their own laws mu, mu', a.s.
   |db| + |dsigma|_F + ||dh||_{L^2(nu)} + |df| <= L(|dX| + |dY| + |dZ|_F + ||dU|| + W_2(mu,mu'));
  (terminal) for all F_T-measurable square-integrable X_T, X'_T, a.s.
   |g(X_T, Law X_T) - g(X'_T, Law X'_T)| <= L(|X_T - X'_T| + W_2(Law X_T, Law X'_T)).
Possibly also L >= 0 (the paper says "there is L >= 0"). Nothing else.

comparison.text:
Assumption23.mk : 0 <= L -> LipInterior F P T L C -> LipTerminal F P T L C.g -> Assumption23 F P T L C.
Exactly the clauses of my reading (L >= 0, the interior bound for a.e. t over all pairs of diagonal
inputs, a.s., and the terminal bound (2.6) over all pairs of F_T-measurable square-integrable X_T),
via LipInterior / LipTerminal whose content I compared under Assumption23 (faithful).
Verdict: faithful.
